# A Document With No Recorded Prompt

This document records its provider and its model but not the prompt that produced it, which makes it unusable as
evidence. A negative sample whose prompt is unknown cannot be reproduced and cannot be audited for contamination
against the rubric it is meant to test.

Records that arrive after their window closed are ordinary in a distributed system. Partitioning on event time and
reprocessing a bounded recent window absorbs them without a person in the loop.

The point of this fixture is the field that is absent from the frontmatter above.
